thread:
lina: midday alert — embeddings pipeline in eu-west1 canary returning 503s since 12:30. suspected regression in quant execution path after last image. need manual pin to previous image and quick approval. @ops_jordan @emma
ops_jordan: any DB/schema changes? data retention impact? :thinking_face:
lina: no DB changes, pure serving binary. previous image tag v2026-02-11 passed staging and sanity tests. smoke run looks good. request: pin canary to v2026-02-11 and do staged traffic shift 10% -> 100% over 10m. no migrations.
deploybot: Deploybot: manual action requested by lina — pin image v2026-02-11 on eu-west1-canary. roll strategy: 10% -> 100% over 10m. To approve, react with :thumbsup:, to abort react with :no_entry:. Command: `/deploy pin --image=v2026-02-11 --env=eu-west1-canary --strategy=staged`
emma: +1 from model team. ran quick inference smoke, responses look normal. :thumbsup:
ryan_oncall: oncall ack, I'll watch logs and latency for 15m.
ops_jordan: infra +1. network and pool capacity look ok for staged shift window 12:40-12:55.
lina: starting pin now.
deploybot: Deploybot: pin applied, initiating traffic shift. 10% -> 100% plan started at 12:42. status: https://deploys.redwood/status/1768409999
lina: error rate dropped from ~8% -> 1.2% at 12:44, good sign.
ryan_oncall: seeing a latency blip on node-3 at 12:45 (p50 +120ms). warmed a spare and cordoned node-3, holding at 10% to observe.
emma: agree hold for 5m. if errors stay low and tail latency normalizes we can proceed to 100%.
ops_jordan: ack. if we hit >2% error or sustained p95 >500ms, rollback plan is to revert to pre-pin image and drain nodes gracefully.
lina: holding. will post final update at 12:52.
(deploybot) Deploybot: reminder — open approvals: none outstanding. automated rollout paused at step 1 per operator hold.
